# Altair justification and finalization

All 10 minimal epoch_processing/justification_and_finalization/pyspec_tests
cases from ethereum/consensus-spec-tests at
bc5c1a7fb2a8871aaffd4b16ee4dd9c72bb81908. Original Snappy and decoded SSZ
pre/post states are retained with paths and hashes in manifest.json.

These qualify the isolated FFG state component, not signature admission,
full epoch processing, fork-choice event replay or network finality.
